name: Kreativ Report Broken Link
description: Find broken internal and external links and export clean maintenance reports.
cardUse: Find broken internal and external links and export clean reports.
metaDescription: Scan internal and external links, detect breakage, and export actionable maintenance reports.

detailItems.title: Internal + external scanning
detailItems.body: Crawls links across your content and highlights broken targets by type, source, and status code.

detailItems.title: Actionable reporting
detailItems.body: Exports clear reports for cleanup sessions so teams can resolve link debt quickly.

detailItems.title: Maintenance-first workflow
detailItems.body: Designed for recurring audits in real WordPress maintenance cycles.

items.title: Site owners doing regular cleanup
items.body: This plugin is built for WordPress teams that need a practical way to find broken internal and external links before they turn into visible trust issues.

items.title: Agencies maintaining multiple sites
items.body: It is especially useful when link checking needs to become a repeatable maintenance task rather than an ad hoc sweep.

items.title: Run a scan, review the report, fix the highest-impact pages
items.body: The plugin is intended to support routine maintenance sessions where teams detect breakage, prioritize the most visible issues, and clean them up in batches.

changelog.label: Status refresh
changelog.body: Plugin page copy and public metadata were refreshed to align with the current Kreativ WP release and maintenance messaging.

changelog.label: Release note link added
changelog.body: The plugin page now links directly to a dedicated update post instead of sending visitors to the generic news index.
